hint: WASD to walk  ·  E to look at something  ·  the way out is south

spots.line: The water goes down further than a fen has any business going.
Duckboards, rotted through in the middle. Somebody laid them and somebody stopped mending them.
A boat, or the idea of one, sunk to its ribs in the mud.
Frogs stop when you stop. They start again before you do.

chests.line: A creel wedged under the bank, tarred against the wet and still holding.

people.name: a heron that has seen worse
chatter: It stands in the shallows and does not concede the ground.
It has been standing there since before you came over the bank.
It watches the water, not you. You are not the interesting thing here.

people.name: Wick, who is fishing
chatter: Nothing in here worth eating. I come for the quiet.
Water's risen a foot since spring. Nobody can tell me why.
Don't drink it. I mean it. Don't.
